newsitem.title: USA: USG buys more shares of CGC.
newsitem.headline: USG buys more shares of CGC.

text.p: USG Corp said it now owns, through a unit, 5.8 million shares of CGC Inc, or 96.3 percent of CGC's outstanding common shares that USG and its affiliates did not previously own.
A USG unit bought an additional 258,872 common shares of CGC under an offer to acquire all of issued and outstanding CGC common shares that USG did not already own for C$11 per share, USG said.

"As a result of acquiring in excess of 90 percent of the common shares of CGC, disregarding common shares previously owned by USG or its affiliates, the offeror (USG) intends to compel the acquisition of the remaining common shares in accordance with applicable legislation," USG said.
USG and CGC make gypsum wallboard and related products.
